features.title: Activate with your pack code
features.description: Open Activate purchased scenery in the terrain library. Verify your purchase email, then enter its activation code.

features.title: Protected downloads
features.description: Signed scenery inventories are checked before installation. Pack keys use Windows protected storage; scenery is cached encrypted.

features.title: Keep building offline
features.description: Once installed, purchased scenery appears in the usual categories and can be placed, saved and exported without internet.

features.title: Your free starter stays free
features.description: The 50-piece Deepstone starter, Campaign Studio and existing scene files are preserved. Premium collections launch separately.
